login.title: Sign in to your account
login.closed: The church's account has been closed. We sent you an email with the deletion date and how to undo it.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryHelp: One of the codes you saved when you turned on verification (for example abcd-2345).
twoFactor.useRecovery: I don't have my phone: use a recovery code
twoFactor.useApp: Use the code from the app

forgot.title: Recover password
forgot.description: We'll send you a link to create a new password. It expires in 30 minutes.
forgot.sent: If the email is registered, you'll receive the link in a few minutes. Check your spam folder too.

reset.title: Create a new password
reset.done: Done: your password was updated. You can sign in now.
reset.invalidLink: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.forcedDescription: For security, before continuing you must replace the temporary password with your own.
changePassword.description: Changing it signs you out on your other devices.

password.hint: At least 10 characters. A phrase of several words is safer and easier to remember.

totp.title: Set up two-step verification
totp.description: As a super administrator you need a second factor. Scan the code with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar.
totp.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
